subject.title: feat(config): add compaction.thinkingLevel to override thinking level during compaction

question: Should OpenClaw expose `agents.defaults.compaction.thinkingLevel` as a public setting when it works for built-in compaction but cannot control Codex-native compaction?
rationale: The code can implement either direction, but accepting another runtime-dependent config contract requires maintainer judgment under the repository's high bar for new configuration surfaces.

options.title: Approve with runtime-scoped docs
options.body: Keep the optional setting, clearly document that built-in compaction honors it and Codex-native compaction currently ignores it, and preserve inherited behavior when unset.

options.title: Decline the new setting
options.body: Avoid another public config key and recommend the existing compaction-only model override for users prioritizing lower cost or reduced reasoning overhead.

recommendation.title: Approve with runtime-scoped docs
recommendation.body: Keep the optional setting, clearly document that built-in compaction honors it and Codex-native compaction currently ignores it, and preserve inherited behavior when unset.

likelyOwner.reason: This person is assigned to the PR and has prior merged history on the Codex-native compaction boundary affected by the decision.
